headline: Chose Freedom Energy as vendor for Community Power program; recommended changing EV charger breakers to 20 amps.
summary: The task force chose Freedom Energy to manage a Community Power program, with supplier quotes expected early next year and a possible April 2027 rollout. It also recommended changing breakers at two charging stations in the Municipal parking lot to 20 amps, and recommended soliciting interest from schools and Pinkerton about educational opportunities for the landfill solar project.
decisions: Approved the meeting minutes 4-0, with one member abstaining.
Chose Freedom Energy as the vendor to manage the roll-out of a Community Power program.
Recommended changing the breakers to 20 amps for the two charging stations in the Municipal parking lot, saving $1470/year.
Recommended soliciting interest from schools and Pinkerton about educational opportunities for the landfill solar project.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve minutes made by Chris and seconded by Dan. Motion passed 4-0 with Colton abstaining.
Community Power: Freedom Energy chosen as the vendor going forward for managing the roll-out of a Community Power program.

Shared a memo to Mike Fowler and Tom Carrier with the Net Zero recommendation to change the breakers to 20 amps for the two charging stations in the Municipal parking lot, saving $1470/year for the town.
New Business: Recommendation to solicit interest from schools & Pinkerton with regard to educational opportunities for the landfill solar project.
